english.title: Purchase / acquire prohibited weapon ( disguised firearm )
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of the Secretary of State, purchased or acquired, a firearm, namely **(..SPECIFY FIREARM..), which was disguised as another object
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1A)(a) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without authority of Secretary of State
purchased/acquired a firearm
disguised as another object

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 5A of the Firearms Act 1968 contains exemptions.
(ii) See also associated offence wordings as follows: H6121 and H6123.
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum 10 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
